entries.description: Educational, job skill, rural skill, and growth center on 52 acres in Estacada, Oregon, with 4 resident lesbians, a visitor's house (Star House), camping space, woods, and farmland. Welcomes lesbian and non-lesbian women and girl and boy children, as well as new members/residents; currently an inactive group hoping to revive.
entries.raw_text: WHO FARM INC 37010 SE Snuffin Rd, Estacada, OR 97023 (503)630-6728. Who farm is an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds. We have 52 acres of beautiful farmland, fields, hills, evergreens, a visitor's house in the magical woods called Star House. Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland with a city bus (NO 31) running within 5 miles of the farm. Visitor s may stay max 2 weeks. We charge $4 per night's stay in Star House. Womyn with dependent children are welcome. Bring your own food. We have very rainy weather and lots of mud so sisters bring rain gear and goulashes! There's no electricity in Star House. We welcome: new members/residents. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 52 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive (trying to get back on our feet).
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it defines itself as 'an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center' with a visitor's house. Land address copied from street address ('37010 SE Snuffin Rd'). Distance to Portland ('approx 30 miles SE of Portland') omitted from land_location_as_stated per codebook. Residents: '4 lesbians' and 'women living on the land'. Accepted groups: 'for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds' and 'Womyn with dependent children are welcome' in 1982 codes Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, and Boy children. Focuses: 'educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center' codes Workshops/education. Inclusiveness statement ('of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds') noted.

entries.description: Non-profit educational community organization on 60 acres in Seal Rock, Oregon, teaching rural skills to women and children. Offers camping spaces, cabins for trade and rent, and group rentals, with women living and working on the land. Welcomes lesbian and non-lesbian women, girl and boy children, and new members/residents.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA, INC Box 97 Star Route 2, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Penthesileia, Inc is a non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children. A matrix between rural and urban. We have camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Group rentals available. No violence. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, leashed dogs, work exchanges. We have/are: 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space as it is an 'educational community organization teaching rural skills' with cabins for rent and group rentals (named in codebook as Retreat/Gathering Space). Land address copied from Star Route address ('Box 97 Star Route 2'). Residents left blank as no number is given for 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory listing), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Focuses: 'educational community organization teaching rural skills' codes Workshops/education.

entries.description: Intentional community of 5 lesbians living and working on land in Roseburg, Oregon, with food and flower gardens, orchards, woods, pasture, chickens, sheep, and ponies. Welcomes lesbian and non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy babies for prearranged visits and work exchange.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END Rt 3 Box 3645, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649. Our land embraces food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies. We're paying for our home by working various jobs in town. Visitor policy: visits must be prearranged by mail or phone. Land use fee: $2-$4 per day, food: $4 per day. Sometimes, for specific projects, work exchange may be arranged. No dogs!!! We welcome: girl children, boy babies, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 5 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land, women working in town.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because 5 lesbians live and work on the land together ('5 lesbians... women living and working on the land'). Land address copied from rural route ('Rt 3 Box 3645'). Residents: '5 lesbians' and 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy babies' - condition: babies only). Focuses: 'food and flower gardens, orchards... We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies' codes Farming/self-sufficiency.

entries.description: Intentional community of 6 lesbians and 4 children living and working on land in Wolf Creek, Oregon, with permanent housing, camping space, woods, and farmland. Welcomes lesbian women, girl and boy children, and new members/residents.
entries.raw_text: GOLDENWIMMIN 3502 Coyote Creek Rd, Wolf Creek, OR 97497 (503)866-2520. We are a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children. Write or call first. Absolutely no drop ins. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children. We have/are: 6 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('group of hard working wimmin and 4 children... 6 lesbians... women living on and working the land'). Land address copied from street/road address ('3502 Coyote Creek Rd'). Residents: 10 (sum of '6 lesbians' and '4 children' who are part of the group living on the land). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children').

entries.description: Feminist retreat on 23 forested acres in Southern Oregon with 5-10 resident lesbians, a main house, women-built cabins, and camping spots. Runs summer and winter sessions with workshops, skillsharing, and discussion groups; welcomes lesbian and non-lesbian women and girl children.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. A feminist retreat on forested land in Southern OR. We plan summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women - workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. We have a main house and several women-built cabins for sleeping and many secluded spots for camping. The main house has electricity, hot water and a shower. Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $1-3/day to our land support fund. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 5-10 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity (outdoor toilet), camping space, woods, farmland, women living/working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('A feminist retreat'). Mailing address is a PO Box ('Box 681'), so land street, city, and zip are left blank; land_state is OR from 'Southern OR'. Residents: '5-10 lesbians' and 'women living/working on the land'; stored smaller number 5, range 5-10 noted. Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('sessions for 10-30 women' in 1982 welcomes all women), Girl children ('We welcome: girl children'). Focuses: 'workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups' codes Workshops/education.

entries.description: Single lesbian living on 16 acres of mostly undeveloped wooded land in Oregon with camping space. Welcomes lesbian women and girl children as visitors for 3-4 days in exchange for work.
entries.raw_text: MULLEINSONG PO Box 302, Applegate, OR 97530. Single woman living on basically undeveloped land. Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for some work. Please write ahead of time. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 16 acres, camping space, woods, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('Single woman living on basically undeveloped land... 1 lesbian'). Mailing address is a PO Box, so land street, city, and zip are blank; land_state is OR from mailing address. Residents: 1 ('1 lesbian... women living on and working the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory), Girl children ('We welcome: girl children').

entries.description: Residential community of about 15 lesbians on the ocean in St. Augustine, Florida, with a community center for visiting members and cottages for lease. Welcomes lesbian women as residents/members, girl children, and non-lesbian women as non-resident members.
entries.raw_text: THE PAGODA COMMUNITY 207 Coastal Hwy-LC, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a residential community with a community center where members can stay for limited visits. Membership is $10-$20/mo. We currently have two cottages available for 1 year lease. We welcome: new members/residents (we rent cottages on a monthly basis only), girl children, nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only). We have/are: about 15 lesbians, small community on ocean, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Printed under 'EDITOR S' NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, but we wanted to include them for your information.' Note that ELLIE'S NEST and RIVER MOST WILD below it are explicitly excluded by the codebook ('Not rows: ... Ellie's Nest, River Most Wild'). Residents: 15 ('We are a residential community... about 15 lesbians'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women, Girl children ('girl children'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only)').
